title: Points Nights on the New Reservation: Free Night Awards Rebooking Reduction
content:
Nights paid otherwise than with Free Night Awards lower the rebooked night's price. When a member applies one of the Free Night Awards that came back from a cancelled stay to a night of another Reward Night Rate reservation, the points-night reduction counts the new reservation's nights not paid with Free Night Awards: at least the upper points-night count earns the upper points-night reduction, exactly one such night the lower points-night reduction, and none nothing. It is taken off the rebooked night's price once.

The count is the nights booked on the new reservation less the nights on it paid with Free Night Awards, both as its Room Reservations record shows them.

| Nights on the new reservation not paid with Free Night Awards | Points-night reduction |
|---|---|
| 2 or more (upper points-night count) | 500 points (upper points-night reduction) |
| Exactly 1 | 250 points (lower points-night reduction) |
| None: every night paid with Free Night Awards | No points-night reduction |

### Hypothetical reservations

| Nights booked | Nights paid with Free Night Awards | Not paid with awards | Reduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | 0 | None |
| 3 | 2 | 1 | 250 |
| 4 | 2 | 2 | 500 |
| 6 | 1 | 5 | 500 |
